page.overview:
Who is Charlotte Anglais?

Charlotte Anglais is the 42nd son and 78th child of the Charlotte Family and a member of the Big Mom Pirates.

Anglais is a young boy with dark hair styled into a . He wears a dark jacket over a light shirt, as well as dark pants. There is a fin-like protrusion on his back.

He is commonly seen riding a pink motorized metal-caterpillar with handlebars.

Anglais appears to be childishly rebellious, making a point while talking to his older siblings to refuse to brush his teeth. He speaks like a stereotypical delinquent. He is, however, loyal to his family, as he reported to his sibling that there was an intruder.
